summary: Tested the new Rateizzazioni fiscali and Situazione finanziaria features end to end. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass. Covered: AI PDF reading with real Gemini on fixtures_piano_ade.pdf (numero 2026/0012345, 4 rate 2026-04-15/07-31/10-31/2027-01-31, capitale 1000, sanzioni 100, interessi 20/15/10/5, pdf_id; AI credits charged 100 -> 97.17); non-PDF -> 400; create/list (totals and stati scaduta/in_scadenza/da_pagare/pagata, rate sorted and numbered), validation (zero-amount rata, empty rate, unknown conto -> 400/422), PUT, soft DELETE (annullata, no longer listed), GET pdf (200 %PDF, 404 without pdf), tenant isolation; paga -> coa_entries origine rateizzazione ref_id {id}-{n}, Dare 13.05.003/30.14.003/40.02.001, Avere bank 06.01.001, coge_rif 'prima nota n. X/2026'; paying twice, a date before the plan date, or a bad conto -> 400; PUT/DELETE refused once a rata is paid; DELETE paga removes the entry and unmarks the rata; paying without contabilita just marks it paid; avvisi scadute/in_scadenza within 15 days; situazione-finanziaria saldo_iniziale from contabilita (-555 after payment) then from bank_accounts saldo (10000, fonte estratto), progressive saldo/netto math checked, mesi 3/6/12, voci include unpaid rate (negative), customer open rata (+1220), supplier open rata (-610) and the F24 IVA estimate. Frontend (Playwright 1920 and 390): dashboard rateizzazioni-panel shown with scadute; menu Tesoreria has both entries; /rateizzazioni plan cards, stati, paga dialog -> Pagata with prima nota ref, annulla -> back to In scadenza, manual plan create/edit/delete, PDF upload via rat-pdf-input -> spinner 'Lettura del PDF…' -> PianoDialog with AI note, 4 rows, editable totals -> saved with PDF button; /situazione-finanziaria KPIs, chart, table, banche, voci and the 3/6/12 toggle all work; both pages fit at mobile width (no horizontal overflow). No page errors. All TEST_T125 data deleted (companies, rateizzazioni, rateizzazioni_pdf, coa_entries, sessions).

minor.issue: The PDF is saved to rateizzazioni_pdf (base64, up to 15 MB) before the user confirms. If the dialog is cancelled the document is never cleaned up, so orphan blobs pile up.

The 'already paid' check is not atomic: the update_one filter does not require rate.$.pagamento == null, so two concurrent requests could create two prima nota entries. The UI disabled button lowers the risk but does not remove it.

If any bank_account has a saldo, only those are summed. Accounting balances and accounts without a saldo are ignored, so liquidity can be understated when the data is mixed (by design, but worth a note in the UI).

The default 40.02.001 is described as 'Interessi passivi bancari'. Interest on deferred tax payments is not bank interest, so a dedicated or more generic interessi passivi sottoconto would fit better (accounting nuance).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Inserisci a mano' opens the dialog with the title 'Controlla il piano letto dal PDF'. The title should depend on f.pdf_id, e.g. 'Nuovo piano di rateizzazione' for manual entry.

issues: oggi() uses new Date().toISOString(), which is UTC. Between 00:00 and 01:00/02:00 Italian time the default date (plan date, payment date) is yesterday.
The rate table and dialog use native <input type=date>, consistent with the rest of the app.

action_items: Low priority: make the PianoDialog title depend on the source (manual vs PDF)
Low priority: clean up orphan rateizzazioni_pdf docs (TTL, or delete when not linked to a plan)
Low priority: make paga atomic (filter rate.n=n and rate.pagamento=null, create the coge entry only if the update matched, or the reverse with rollback)
Optional: use a local date instead of the UTC ISO date for defaults in Rateizzazioni/PagaRataDialog
critical_code_review_comments: rateizzazioni.py is clean (318 lines), Pydantic-validated, tenant-scoped on every query, and excludes _id
leggi-pdf charges AI credits even when the model returns no rate (acceptable, since tokens were used)
The paga race condition and the orphan PDFs are listed above
seed_data_creation: Test creates its own TEST_T125 companies (contabilita on and off), a session token test_session_t125_admin, plans, a bank_account with saldo, and a customer invoice plus passive invoice. clean() deletes everything at the start and end. Verified 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iteration125_rateizzazioni.py -v -n 0 (real Gemini call in test_02, about 15s). T125_KEEP=1 keeps the data in /tmp/t125.json (cid, cid2, P, P_ai, tok) for UI tests: set the session_token cookie and localStorage fe_company_id. Then run the suite again without KEEP, which cleans at setup. The NSelect paga-rata-conto is a Radix combobox, not a native select. The preview date is around 2026-11-23.
